story.title: Flavio Bolsonaro Officially Launches Presidential Campaign in Brazil
story.summary: Flavio Bolsonaro, a Brazilian senator and son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, has officially launched his presidential campaign to challenge incumbent President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in the upcoming October elections. He received endorsements from Argentine President Javier Milei and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, along with a message from his jailed father.

explore_lenses.label: What did the party convention actually change?
explore_lenses.title: Party nomination, not the final ballot filing
explore_lenses.summary: The Liberal Party's July 25 convention selected Flávio Bolsonaro as its presidential nominee, but the ticket still must be formally registered with Brazil's electoral authorities. The campaign also remains incomplete because no running mate has been announced.

claims.text: The Liberal Party confirmed Flávio Bolsonaro as its presidential candidate at its convention in São Paulo on July 25.
Under the Superior Electoral Court's 2026 calendar, party conventions run through August 5 and parties, federations, or coalitions have until August 15 to formally register candidacies.
AP reported that Bolsonaro still had not selected a vice-presidential running mate at the time of the convention.
General election campaigning in the streets and online is scheduled to begin on August 16; the first-round vote is October 4, with a possible runoff on October 25.

explore_lenses.uncertainty_note: The reporting reviewed does not establish when Bolsonaro will name a running mate or whether the electoral court will face any challenge to the eventual registration.

explore_lenses.label: Can Bolsonaro build a wider coalition?
explore_lenses.title: The central challenge is winning moderates and allies
explore_lenses.summary: The launch displayed international and family support, but reporting indicated that Bolsonaro lacked a completed ticket and broad centrist backing. His relationship with Michelle Bolsonaro appears to have improved, though the durability and electoral effect of that reconciliation are unresolved.

claims.text: AP reported that Bolsonaro did not have the centrist-party support that aided Jair Bolsonaro's 2018 election and that few major Brazilian political figures attended the convention.
AP reported that Bolsonaro had not secured a high-profile female running mate and that the Popular Party, important to Jair Bolsonaro's presidency, had distanced itself from his bid.
Michelle Bolsonaro accepted Flávio Bolsonaro's public apology and issued a video supporting his candidacy after their recent dispute.
Forecast: Political consultant Thomas Traumann told AP that Bolsonaro would have a substantially harder time appealing to moderate voters than earlier in his campaign.

related_stories.title: Troy Jackson Secures Democratic Nomination for U.S. Senate in Maine
related_stories.summary: Troy Jackson, a former state lawmaker and logger, has been chosen as the Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate in Maine. He will challenge incumbent Republican Senator Susan Collins in the upcoming November election. Jackson replaces Graham Platner, who initially won the Democratic primary in June.

related_stories.title: Resignation of India's Education Minister Follows Student Protests
related_stories.summary: Indian Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned amid significant pressure from student-led protests known as the 'Cockroach Movement.' His resignation marks a notable victory for the youth movement, which had organized nationwide demonstrations, sit-ins, and hunger strikes in response to an exam leak scandal. Following his resignation, the movement's organizers announced that they would call off future protests as the government had accepted their demands.

related_stories.title: UN Chief Calls for Global Support for Syria's Recovery
related_stories.summary: United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres visited Syria, marking the first visit by a UN chief since 2009. During his visit, he emphasized the need for international support as the country faces a critical phase in its recovery from civil war. Guterres held discussions with interim President Ahmed al-Sharaa, highlighting the pivotal moment for Syria's future.

related_stories.title: Trump Issues Order for Disclaimers at Smithsonian Museum
related_stories.summary: President Donald Trump has ordered the installation of signs at the Smithsonian's National Museum of American History. These signs will inform visitors that some exhibits may contain inaccurate historical information.
